title: Tournament deleted (DELETE /api/tournaments/:slug, 200)
description: Reader: OpenPairings (it reads the status only). Removes every snapshot, the registration queue and the key claim (and with them the live games and relay keys). Request: no body; Authorization as for a publish; X-OpenResults-Key the tournament's key (or, operator token only, the ingest token as break-glass). Idempotent: 200 with zero counts when nothing was there. Refusals: 401 unauthorized; 403 key_required, key_mismatch, not_owner.

snapshots.description: Snapshot rows removed, the whole history.
